bullet_points: Load galaxy and halo catalogs for all 10 realizations.
Derive R_vir for each halo using the standard cosmological relation (M_vir proportional to R_vir^3).
Use a KD-Tree to match each galaxy to its nearest host halo, applying periodic boundary conditions.
Print summary statistics (number of matched galaxies, satellite fraction, mean halo mass per bin) to validate matching quality.
Save the matched dataset (galaxy-halo associations) for subsequent analysis.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Load the 10 galaxy and halo catalogs, derive R_vir, and perform spatial matching.

bullet_points: Partition host halos into logarithmic mass bins (M >= 10^13 M_sun/h).
Calculate satellite distances from host centers using the minimum image convention for periodic boundaries.
Compute the stacked radial density profile n(r|M_vir) by normalizing counts by shell volume (4*pi*r^2*dr).
Save the profiles and associated statistics for all mass bins.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Compute stacked radial density profiles n(r|M_vir) for satellite galaxies.

bullet_points: Fit the observed 3D satellite radial distributions to a PDF proportional to r^2 * exp(-r/lambda).
Generate a null model by shuffling satellite positions within host halos, preserving the number of satellites per halo and halo center positions.
Compare the goodness-of-fit of the exponential model against the null model and a Gaussian profile.
Save the fitted parameters and goodness-of-fit metrics.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Perform MLE to fit satellite radial distributions to a 3D exponential kernel and compare with a null model.

bullet_points: Compute the 2PCF using the Landy-Szalay estimator with a random catalog at least 10x larger than the data.
Apply periodic boundary conditions in pair counting.
Label galaxies by type (central vs. satellite) before pair counting to isolate "central-satellite" and "satellite-satellite" contributions.
Save the 2PCF components and covariance matrices.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Isolate the 1-halo regime (r < 5 Mpc/h) and compute the 2PCF.

bullet_points: Compute M(r) for the full satellite population as a baseline.
Compute M(r) within narrow host halo mass bins to control for mass-luminosity relations.
Define M(r) as the ratio of mark-weighted pair counts to unweighted pair counts, normalized by the mean mark squared.
Save the marked correlation results.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Compute the marked correlation function M(r) using luminosity as a mark.

bullet_points: Aggregate radial profiles, 2PCF components, and marked correlation functions across all 10 realizations.
Compute both diagonal errors and the full covariance matrix for all spatial statistics.
Calculate chi^2 statistics using the inverse of the covariance matrix for model fits.
Generate plots: stacked radial profiles with model fits, 1-halo 2PCF components with error bars, and marked correlation functions.
Save all plots as high-resolution PNG files and save the covariance matrices to disk.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Aggregate results, compute covariance matrices, and generate final plots.

bullet_points: Report key numerical results: fitted scale parameters (lambda/R_vir) with uncertainties, chi^2/dof for model comparisons, and amplitude ratios of 2PCF components.
Interpret the performance of the exponential kernel model and the impact of luminosity marks on spatial clustering.
Discuss whether systematic trends in the fitted scale parameter with halo mass indicate biases in the HOD spatial implementation.
Provide a final assessment of the HOD spatial implementation based on the aggregated statistics.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Synthesize the findings into a comprehensive results report.
